item.title: Traffic Stop Results in Humiliation and Thousands of Dollars Billed to Victim
item.description: #TorrenceJackson was pulled over for signaling late. His experience with the Syracuse Police Department ended with a brutal physical attack by arresting officers, a judge-sanctioned anal probe against his consent by the hospital, and a hospital bill of $4600.00.

item.title: LDF Condemns Governor Hochul’s Plan to Deploy National Guard, State Police into NYC Transit System
item.description: Governor Kathy Hochul announced a plan that includes deploying 1,000 members of the U.S. National Guard and NY State police throughout NYC’s transit system.

item.title: LDF Mourns the Loss of William “Bill” Lucy, Visionary Leader of Labor Movement and Champion of Civil and Human Rights
